use_case: Gateway machine-learning fraud-scoring filter: scores each card-not-present transaction for about 120 e-commerce merchants; the company sets the default decline and hold thresholds for its merchants
vendor_or_model: Processor partner's fraud-scoring model, built into the gateway; the company cannot see or change the model, only the thresholds and actions per merchant
data_categories: Transaction amount and time; card type and issuing country (from the card's first digits); billing address match; IP address and device signals; email address; merchant category
consequential_decision_category: None of the listed categories (purchase screening, not a credit decision). Medium tier because it declines consumer purchases automatically at the top band
human_in_the_loop: Today: automatic decline at score 80 and above, merchant review for 60 to 79. Decision: automatic decline only at 90 and above; 70 to 89 held for the merchant to approve or decline; merchants can override and allow-list customers
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45 (unfair practices; deceptive claims to merchants); PCI DSS 6.5.1 (changes to gateway settings); Colorado SB26-189 (effective 2027-01-01) applicability to be assessed by counsel

use_case: Staff use of public generative AI chatbots to compare merchant statements and draft pricing proposals
vendor_or_model: Public consumer chatbots today; business AI assistant with no-training terms approved 2026-08-31
data_categories: Merchant statements (merchant name, volumes, fees); risk of merchant owner or card data being pasted
risk_tier: Medium (Low once public chatbots are blocked and the business assistant is in use)
human_in_the_loop: Staff review every output; nothing sent to a merchant without review
applicable_laws: 16 CFR 314.4(c)(1) and (f) (information disclosed to an unapproved provider); PCI DSS 12.2.1 (acceptable use); POL-02 C.2 and C.3
status: Public chatbots prohibited for work from 2026-09-01; business assistant rollout by 2026-10-31

use_case: CRM built-in AI writing assistant that summarizes merchant files and drafts emails (vendor feature switched on by default in June 2026)
data_categories: Merchant files, including owner Social Security numbers and bank details
risk_tier: Medium until the vendor's data use terms are confirmed
applicable_laws: 16 CFR 314.4(f); Fla. Stat. 501.171 (merchant owner personal information); POL-04 4.6
status: Switched off 2026-08-25 until the CRM vendor confirms no training on company data and data location terms
